description: AT-PRIME is an ERC Proof-of-Concept project aiming to advance PRIME editing technology to broaden the scope of gene correction therapies.

founders_enriched.source_of_identity: Affiliated with UMC Utrecht and specializes in metabolic disorders and innovative therapies.

funding_summary: Funded under the European Research Council's (ERC) Proof-of-Concept grant with a net EU contribution of €150,000.
inflection_why_now: The project's initiation in 2026 coincides with significant advancements in gene editing technologies, positioning AT-PRIME to capitalize on emerging therapeutic needs.
devils_advocate_risks: Technical Risk: Achieving high editing efficiency in AT-rich DNA loci may present unforeseen challenges.
Regulatory Risk: Navigating the regulatory landscape for new gene therapies could delay development timelines.

lp_synergy_matches.reason: Their focus on innovative therapies aligns with AT-PRIME's goal of advancing gene correction treatments.
Specializing in sample and assay technologies, QIAGEN could support AT-PRIME in developing diagnostic tools for gene editing applications.
